value.rationale: Prior environmental model takes mixing parameters from independent regression; the new inverse identifies these physically motivated parameters from exactly two independently known reactive uptake readings and gives the exact feasible data wedge. One-reading nonidentifiability is established, not merely asserted; feasibility is scientifically useful to diagnose model incompatibility before calibration. The result is a motivated structural inverse benchmark, not a routine parameter substitution or arbitrary numerical slice.
